newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps -Diesel rise on supply squeeze.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps -Diesel rise on supply squeeze.

text.p: Singapore gas oil swaps rose late afternoon on Wednesday on sustained buying of the front month on tight prompt supplies, market sources said.
December gas oil swaps traded at an intra day high of $31.22 this afternoon and was last quoted at $31.15/$31.25, up about 20 cents from this morning, brokers said.
The market has been strong over the past few days due to renewed buying interest by traders in Singapore for spot prompt cargoes with demand still outstanding in China, traders said.
In the Singapore physical market a 150,000-barrel cargo traded late Tuesday at a new five-year high of $31.50 a barrel free-on-board, up 70 cents from the previous record.
China earlier this week bought a 30,000-tonne cargo for arrival in December at $241 per tonne on a cost and freight basis, up about $5 over the previous deal done last week.
Traders said the market may ease slightly on expectations of exports from the west due to the widening east-west spread which is currently at about $14.50 a tonne in favour of the east.
They said that some traders would be looking to move cargoes from the west to Asia if they could source prompt loading cargoes.
The December/January backwardation is at a steep $1.00/$1.10 which makes arbitrage exports for the further out months, they said.

Jet fuel fell as sellers returned to the market on talks that North Asia had covered most of its December requiremnt. The jet fuel/gas oil spread (regrade) was quoted lower due to the strong gas oil prices with several offers seen for December regrade at $1.90, down 30 cents from this morning.
December jet fuel was offered late afternoon at $33.00, down about 60 cents from this morning's offered level.
Naphtha edged up slightly in line with higher crude values with December last quoted at $23.50/$23.80, up about 20 cents from the morning.
Fuel oil was unchanged from midday with December swaps were last quoted in quiet trade at $119.25/$120.00.
